tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Searches the Softwear Prints catalogue of textiles and promotional items that can be printed or embroidered. Supports free text and filters for category, brand, colour, size, target group, material, certification and price. Returns name, brand, article number, unit price (net and gross), colours and

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Returns the details of one product: description, properties such as material and certifications, colours, sizes, unit price (net and gross), EAN and stock per variant, and the minimum quantities and production time for decoration.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Returns the category tree of the Softwear Prints catalogue with product counts and links. The slugs can be used as the category filter of search_products.

tools.name: start_own_shop
tools.description: Explains the Softwear Prints online shop plans (free, Professional, Enterprise) with prices and returns a link to set up an own shop on softwear-prints.com (staff shop, club or team shop, school, merchandise or event shop), prefilled with the organisation name and type.
